captureMode.how: Hand-authored HTML/CSS recreations (no live app, no network, no JS). Rendered through scripts/static-capture.mjs via scripts/specs-huf-android.mjs, then scripts/huf-mobile/android-meta.mjs adds slot types, typing slots and states. Previews render at the 412x892 dp Pixel 5 viewport; screens are compared to emulator refs with compare-android.mjs.
captureMode.builder: scripts/huf-mobile/build-android.mjs (+ build-android-lib.mjs) generates components/huf-android-*/ and scripts/specs-huf-android.mjs

variableSystem.kind: css-custom-properties (--ha-*) mirroring HufTheme LightHufColors / DarkHufColors, HufSpacing, HufRadius, HufLayout

tokens.fonts: Inter variable (OFL, tokens/fonts) with size-adjust 95% standing in for Roboto; Geist Mono for the drawer 'AI PLATFORM' label
tokens.icons: Material icon paths inlined as SVG (build-android-lib.mjs)

rtl.mechanism: Compose app supports Arabic (values-ar) but this system ships English only

animation.typing: huf-android-composer slot `draft` (typing:true); screens expose it via slots.json typing
animation.states: pressed (= active), loading/busy, closed/open for sheets, drawer and menu, failed, verifying
